# stripe_terminal_reader (Resource)

A Stripe Terminal card reader registered at a location. `terraform destroy` deletes the reader. Only `label` and `metadata` change in place: changing the `location` or the `registration_code` creates a new reader. Stripe never returns the `registration_code`, so an imported reader has none in state: a configuration that sets it plans a replacement unless it ignores changes to it with `lifecycle { ignore_changes = [registration_code] }`. In test mode the registration code `simulated-wpe` registers a simulated reader. The reader's `action` reports the most recent action it performed; the resource does not start actions, and the nested objects of an action's API error are not available.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "stripe_terminal_location" "store" {
  display_name = "Main Street store"

  address = {
    line1       = "1 Main St"
    city        = "Springfield"
    postal_code = "12345"
    country     = "US"
  }
}

# Enter the code the reader shows when you register it. In test mode, `simulated-wpe`
# registers a simulated reader.
resource "stripe_terminal_reader" "counter" {
  registration_code = "simulated-wpe"
  location          = stripe_terminal_location.store.id
  label             = "Front counter"

  metadata = {
    lane = "1"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `registration_code` (String) A code generated by the reader used for registering to an account. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `label` (String) Custom label given to the reader for easier identification. If no label is specified, the registration code will be used.
- `location` (String) The location to assign the reader to. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value to them. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to `metadata`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `action` (Attributes) The most recent action performed by the reader. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action))
- `device_sw_version` (String) The current software version of the reader.
- `device_type` (String) Device type of the reader. Possible values: `bbpos_chipper2x`, `bbpos_wisepad3`, `bbpos_wisepos_e`, `mobile_phone_reader`, `simulated_stripe_s700`, `simulated_stripe_s710`, `simulated_verifone_m425`, `simulated_verifone_p630`, `simulated_verifone_ux700`, `simulated_verifone_v660p`, `simulated_wisepos_e`, `stripe_m2`, `stripe_s700`, `stripe_s710`, `verifone_P400`, `verifone_m425`, `verifone_p630`, `verifone_ux700`, `verifone_v660p`.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the object.
- `ip_address` (String) The local IP address of the reader.
- `last_seen_at` (Number) The last time this reader reported to Stripe backend. Timestamp is measured in milliseconds since the Unix epoch. Unlike most other Stripe timestamp fields which use seconds, this field uses milliseconds.
- `livemode` (Boolean) If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
- `serial_number` (String) Serial number of the reader.
- `status` (String) The networking status of the reader. This value is `null` for mobile readers. We do not recommend using this field in flows that may block taking payments. Possible values: `offline`, `online`.

Read-Only:

Avoid parsing the `message` field for programmatic logic; use `type` or `code` instead. The `message` field is for display to humans only and may be updated at anytime. Read-Only:

### Nested Schema for `action.api_error.payment_method.card`

Read-Only:

- `brand` (String) Card brand. Can be `amex`, `cartes_bancaires`, `diners`, `discover`, `eftpos_au`, `jcb`, `link`, `mastercard`, `unionpay`, `visa` or `unknown`.
- `checks` (Attributes) Checks on Card address and CVC if provided. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action--api_error--payment_method--card--checks))
- `country` (String) Two-letter ISO code representing the country of the card. You could use this attribute to get a sense of the international breakdown of cards you've collected.
- `display_brand` (String) The brand to use when displaying the card, this accounts for customer's brand choice on dual-branded cards. Can be `american_express`, `cartes_bancaires`, `diners_club`, `discover`, `eftpos_australia`, `interac`, `jcb`, `mastercard`, `union_pay`, `visa`, or `other` and may contain more values in the future.
- `exp_month` (Number) Two-digit number representing the card's expiration month.
- `exp_year` (Number) Four-digit number representing the card's expiration year.
- `fingerprint` (String) Uniquely identifies this particular card number. You can use this attribute to check whether two customers who’ve signed up with you are using the same card number, for example. For payment methods that tokenize card information (Apple Pay, Google Pay), the tokenized number might be provided instead of the underlying card number. *As of May 1, 2021, card fingerprint in India for Connect changed to allow two fingerprints for the same card---one for India and one for the rest of the world.*

- `last4` (String) The last four digits of the card.
- `networks` (Attributes) Contains information about card networks that can be used to process the payment. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action--api_error--payment_method--card--networks))
- `regulated_status` (String) Status of a card based on the card issuer. Possible values: `regulated`, `unregulated`.
- `three_d_secure_usage` (Attributes) Contains details on how this Card may be used for 3D Secure authentication. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action--api_error--payment_method--card--three_d_secure_usage))
- `wallet` (Attributes) If this Card is part of a card wallet, this contains the details of the card wallet. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action--api_error--payment_method--card--wallet))

### Nested Schema for `action.api_error.payment_method.card.generated_from.payment_method_details.card_present`

Read-Only:

- `amount_authorized` (Number) The authorized amount
- `brand` (String) Card brand. Can be `amex`, `cartes_bancaires`, `diners`, `discover`, `eftpos_au`, `jcb`, `link`, `mastercard`, `unionpay`, `visa` or `unknown`.

May include alphanumeric characters, special characters and first/last name separator (`/`). In some cases, the cardholder name may not be available depending on how the issuer has configured the card. Cardholder name is typically not available on swipe or contactless payments, such as those made with Apple Pay and Google Pay.
- `country` (String) Two-letter ISO code representing the country of the card. You could use this attribute to get a sense of the international breakdown of cards you've collected.
- `description` (String) A high-level description of the type of cards issued in this range.
- `emv_auth_data` (String) Authorization response cryptogram.
- `exp_month` (Number) Two-digit number representing the card's expiration month.
- `exp_year` (Number) Four-digit number representing the card's expiration year.
- `fingerprint` (String) Uniquely identifies this particular card number. You can use this attribute to check whether two customers who’ve signed up with you are using the same card number, for example. For payment methods that tokenize card information (Apple Pay, Google Pay), the tokenized number might be provided instead of the underlying card number. *As of May 1, 2021, card fingerprint in India for Connect changed to allow two fingerprints for the same card---one for India and one for the rest of the world.*
- `funding` (String) Card funding type. Can be `credit`, `debit`, `prepaid`, or `unknown`.
- `generated_card` (String) ID of a card PaymentMethod generated from the card_present PaymentMethod that may be attached to a Customer for future transactions. Only present if it was possible to generate a card PaymentMethod.
- `incremental_authorization_supported` (Boolean) Whether this [PaymentIntent](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents) is eligible for incremental authorizations. Request support using [request_incremental_authorization_support](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents/create#create_payment_intent-payment_method_options-card_present-request_incremental_authorization_support).
- `issuer` (String) The name of the card's issuing bank.
- `last4` (String) The last four digits of the card.
- `location` (String) ID of the [location](https://docs.stripe.com/api/terminal/locations) that this transaction's reader is assigned to.
- `network` (String) Identifies which network this charge was processed on. Can be `amex`, `cartes_bancaires`, `diners`, `discover`, `eftpos_au`, `interac`, `jcb`, `link`, `mastercard`, `unionpay`, `visa`, or `unknown`.
- `network_transaction_id` (String) This is used by the financial networks to identify a transaction. Visa calls this the Transaction ID, Mastercard calls this the Trace ID, and American Express calls this the Acquirer Reference Data. This value will be present if it is returned by the financial network in the authorization response, and null otherwise.
- `offline` (Attributes) Details about payments collected offline. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action--api_error--payment_method--card--generated_from--payment_method_details--card_present--offline))
- `overcapture_supported` (Boolean) Defines whether the authorized amount can be over-captured or not
- `preferred_locales` (List of String) The languages that the issuing bank recommends using for localizing any customer-facing text, as read from the card. Referenced from EMV tag 5F2D, data encoded on the card's chip.
- `read_method` (String) How card details were read in this transaction. Possible values: `contact_emv`, `contactless_emv`, `contactless_magstripe_mode`, `magnetic_stripe_fallback`, `magnetic_stripe_track2`.
- `reader` (String) ID of the [reader](https://docs.stripe.com/api/terminal/readers) this transaction was made on.
- `receipt` (Attributes) A collection of fields required to be displayed on receipts. Only required for EMV transactions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action--api_error--payment_method--card--generated_from--payment_method_details--card_present--receipt))

<a id="nestedatt--action--api_error--payment_method--card--generated_from--payment_method_details--card_present--receipt"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.api_error.payment_method.card.generated_from.payment_method_details.card_present.receipt`

Read-Only:

- `account_type` (String) The type of account being debited or credited Possible values: `checking`, `credit`, `prepaid`, `unknown`.
- `application_cryptogram` (String) The Application Cryptogram, a unique value generated by the card to authenticate the transaction with issuers.
- `application_preferred_name` (String) The Application Identifier (AID) on the card used to determine which networks are eligible to process the transaction. Referenced from EMV tag 9F12, data encoded on the card's chip.
- `authorization_code` (String) Identifier for this transaction.
- `authorization_response_code` (String) EMV tag 8A. A code returned by the card issuer.
- `cardholder_verification_method` (String) Describes the method used by the cardholder to verify ownership of the card. One of the following: `approval`, `failure`, `none`, `offline_pin`, `offline_pin_and_signature`, `online_pin`, or `signature`.
- `dedicated_file_name` (String) Similar to the application_preferred_name, identifying the applications (AIDs) available on the card. Referenced from EMV tag 84.
- `terminal_verification_results` (String) A 5-byte string that records the checks and validations that occur between the card and the terminal. These checks determine how the terminal processes the transaction and what risk tolerance is acceptable. Referenced from EMV Tag 95.
- `transaction_status_information` (String) An indication of which steps were completed during the card read process. Referenced from EMV Tag 9B.

Read-Only:

May include alphanumeric characters, special characters and first/last name separator (`/`). In some cases, the cardholder name may not be available depending on how the issuer has configured the card. Cardholder name is typically not available on swipe or contactless payments, such as those made with Apple Pay and Google Pay.

<a id="nestedatt--action--collect_payment_method--payment_method--card"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.card`

Read-Only:

- `brand` (String) Card brand. Can be `amex`, `cartes_bancaires`, `diners`, `discover`, `eftpos_au`, `jcb`, `link`, `mastercard`, `unionpay`, `visa` or `unknown`.
- `checks` (Attributes) Checks on Card address and CVC if provided. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action--collect_payment_method--payment_method--card--checks))

Can be `american_express`, `cartes_bancaires`, `diners_club`, `discover`, `eftpos_australia`, `interac`, `jcb`, `mastercard`, `union_pay`, `visa`, or `other` and may contain more values in the future.

- `exp_year` (Number) Four-digit number representing the card's expiration year.
- `fingerprint` (String) Uniquely identifies this particular card number. You can use this attribute to check whether two customers who’ve signed up with you are using the same card number, for example. For payment methods that tokenize card information (Apple Pay, Google Pay), the tokenized number might be provided instead of the underlying card number. *As of May 1, 2021, card fingerprint in India for Connect changed to allow two fingerprints for the same card---one for India and one for the rest of the world.*
- `funding` (String) Card funding type. Can be `credit`, `debit`, `prepaid`, or `unknown`.
- `generated_from` (Attributes) Details of the original PaymentMethod that created this object. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action--collect_payment_method--payment_method--card--generated_from))
- `last4` (String) The last four digits of the card.
- `networks` (Attributes) Contains information about card networks that can be used to process the payment. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action--collect_payment_method--payment_method--card--networks))
- `regulated_status` (String) Status of a card based on the card issuer. Possible values: `regulated`, `unregulated`.
- `three_d_secure_usage` (Attributes) Contains details on how this Card may be used for 3D Secure authentication. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action--collect_payment_method--payment_method--card--three_d_secure_usage))
- `wallet` (Attributes) If this Card is part of a card wallet, this contains the details of the card wallet. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action--collect_payment_method--payment_method--card--wallet))

Read-Only:

- `amount_authorized` (Number) The authorized amount
- `brand` (String) Card brand. Can be `amex`, `cartes_bancaires`, `diners`, `discover`, `eftpos_au`, `jcb`, `link`, `mastercard`, `unionpay`, `visa` or `unknown`.
- `brand_product` (String) The [product code](https://stripe.com/docs/card-product-codes) that identifies the specific program or product associated with a card.
- `capture_before` (Number) When using manual capture, a future timestamp after which the charge will be automatically refunded if uncaptured.
- `cardholder_name` (String) The cardholder name as read from the card, in [ISO 7813](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO/IEC_7813) format. May include alphanumeric characters, special characters and first/last name separator (`/`). In some cases, the cardholder name may not be available depending on how the issuer has configured the card. Cardholder name is typically not available on swipe or contactless payments, such as those made with Apple Pay and Google Pay.
- `country` (String) Two-letter ISO code representing the country of the card. You could use this attribute to get a sense of the international breakdown of cards you've collected.
- `description` (String) A high-level description of the type of cards issued in this range.
- `emv_auth_data` (String) Authorization response cryptogram.
- `exp_month` (Number) Two-digit number representing the card's expiration month.
- `exp_year` (Number) Four-digit number representing the card's expiration year.
- `fingerprint` (String) Uniquely identifies this particular card number. You can use this attribute to check whether two customers who’ve signed up with you are using the same card number, for example. For payment methods that tokenize card information (Apple Pay, Google Pay), the tokenized number might be provided instead of the underlying card number. *As of May 1, 2021, card fingerprint in India for Connect changed to allow two fingerprints for the same card---one for India and one for the rest of the world.*
- `funding` (String) Card funding type. Can be `credit`, `debit`, `prepaid`, or `unknown`.
- `generated_card` (String) ID of a card PaymentMethod generated from the card_present PaymentMethod that may be attached to a Customer for future transactions. Only present if it was possible to generate a card PaymentMethod.
- `incremental_authorization_supported` (Boolean) Whether this [PaymentIntent](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents) is eligible for incremental authorizations. Request support using [request_incremental_authorization_support](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents/create#create_payment_intent-payment_method_options-card_present-request_incremental_authorization_support).
- `issuer` (String) The name of the card's issuing bank.
- `last4` (String) The last four digits of the card.
- `location` (String) ID of the [location](https://docs.stripe.com/api/terminal/locations) that this transaction's reader is assigned to.
- `network` (String) Identifies which network this charge was processed on. Can be `amex`, `cartes_bancaires`, `diners`, `discover`, `eftpos_au`, `interac`, `jcb`, `link`, `mastercard`, `unionpay`, `visa`, or `unknown`.
- `network_transaction_id` (String) This is used by the financial networks to identify a transaction. Visa calls this the Transaction ID, Mastercard calls this the Trace ID, and American Express calls this the Acquirer Reference Data. This value will be present if it is returned by the financial network in the authorization response, and null otherwise.
- `offline` (Attributes) Details about payments collected offline. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action--collect_payment_method--payment_method--card--generated_from--payment_method_details--card_present--offline))
- `overcapture_supported` (Boolean) Defines whether the authorized amount can be over-captured or not
- `preferred_locales` (List of String) The languages that the issuing bank recommends using for localizing any customer-facing text, as read from the card. Referenced from EMV tag 5F2D, data encoded on the card's chip.
- `read_method` (String) How card details were read in this transaction. Possible values: `contact_emv`, `contactless_emv`, `contactless_magstripe_mode`, `magnetic_stripe_fallback`, `magnetic_stripe_track2`.
- `reader` (String) ID of the [reader](https://docs.stripe.com/api/terminal/readers) this transaction was made on.
- `receipt` (Attributes) A collection of fields required to be displayed on receipts. Only required for EMV transactions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action--collect_payment_method--payment_method--card--generated_from--payment_method_details--card_present--receipt))
- `wallet` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action--collect_payment_method--payment_method--card--generated_from--payment_method_details--card_present--wallet))

Read-Only:

- `stored_at` (Number) Time at which the payment was collected while offline
- `type` (String) The method used to process this payment method offline. Only deferred is allowed. Possible values: `deferred`.


<a id="nestedatt--action--collect_payment_method--payment_method--card--generated_from--payment_method_details--card_present--receipt"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.card.generated_from.payment_method_details.card_present.receipt`

Read-Only:

- `account_type` (String) The type of account being debited or credited Possible values: `checking`, `credit`, `prepaid`, `unknown`.
- `application_cryptogram` (String) The Application Cryptogram, a unique value generated by the card to authenticate the transaction with issuers.
- `application_preferred_name` (String) The Application Identifier (AID) on the card used to determine which networks are eligible to process the transaction. Referenced from EMV tag 9F12, data encoded on the card's chip.
- `authorization_code` (String) Identifier for this transaction.
- `authorization_response_code` (String) EMV tag 8A. A code returned by the card issuer.
- `cardholder_verification_method` (String) Describes the method used by the cardholder to verify ownership of the card. One of the following: `approval`, `failure`, `none`, `offline_pin`, `offline_pin_and_signature`, `online_pin`, or `signature`.
- `dedicated_file_name` (String) Similar to the application_preferred_name, identifying the applications (AIDs) available on the card. Referenced from EMV tag 84.
- `terminal_verification_results` (String) A 5-byte string that records the checks and validations that occur between the card and the terminal. These checks determine how the terminal processes the transaction and what risk tolerance is acceptable. Referenced from EMV Tag 95.
- `transaction_status_information` (String) An indication of which steps were completed during the card read process. Referenced from EMV Tag 9B.

- `available` (List of String) All networks available for selection via [payment_method_options.card.network](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents/confirm#confirm_payment_intent-payment_method_options-card-network).
- `preferred` (String) The preferred network for the card.



<a id="nestedatt--action--collect_payment_method--payment_method--klarna"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.klarna`

Read-Only:

- `dob` (Attributes) The customer's date of birth, if provided. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action--collect_payment_method--payment_method--klarna--dob))

<a id="nestedatt--action--collect_payment_method--payment_method--klarna--dob"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.klarna.dob`

Read-Only:

- `day` (Number) The day of birth, between 1 and 31.
- `month` (Number) The month of birth, between 1 and 12.
- `year` (Number) The four-digit year of birth.



<a id="nestedatt--action--collect_payment_method--payment_method--kr_card"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.kr_card`

Read-Only:

- `brand` (String) The local credit or debit card brand. Possible values: `bc`, `citi`, `hana`, `hyundai`, `jeju`, `jeonbuk`, `kakaobank`, `kbank`, `kdbbank`, `kookmin`, `kwangju`, `lotte`, `mg`, `nh`, `post`, `samsung`, `savingsbank`, `shinhan`, `shinhyup`, `suhyup`, `tossbank`, `woori`.
- `last4` (String) The last four digits of the card. This may not be present for American Express cards.


<a id="nestedatt--action--collect_payment_method--payment_method--link"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.link`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) Account owner's email address.


<a id="nestedatt--action--collect_payment_method--payment_method--naver_pay"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.naver_pay`

Read-Only:

- `buyer_id` (String) Uniquely identifies this particular Naver Pay account. You can use this attribute to check whether two Naver Pay accounts are the same.
- `funding` (String) Whether to fund this transaction with Naver Pay points or a card. Possible values: `card`, `points`.


<a id="nestedatt--action--collect_payment_method--payment_method--nz_bank_account"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.nz_bank_account`

Read-Only:

- `account_holder_name` (String) The name on the bank account. Only present if the account holder name is different from the name of the authorized signatory collected in the PaymentMethod’s billing details.
- `bank_code` (String) The numeric code for the bank account's bank.
- `bank_name` (String) The name of the bank.
- `branch_code` (String) The numeric code for the bank account's bank branch.
- `last4` (String) Last four digits of the bank account number.
- `suffix` (String) The suffix of the bank account number.


<a id="nestedatt--action--collect_payment_method--payment_method--p24"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.p24`

Read-Only:

- `bank` (String) The customer's bank, if provided. Possible values: `alior_bank`, `bank_millennium`, `bank_nowy_bfg_sa`, `bank_pekao_sa`, `banki_spbdzielcze`, `blik`, `bnp_paribas`, `boz`, `citi_handlowy`, `credit_agricole`, `envelobank`, `etransfer_pocztowy24`, `getin_bank`, `ideabank`, `ing`, `inteligo`, `mbank_mtransfer`, `nest_przelew`, `noble_pay`, `pbac_z_ipko`, `plus_bank`, `santander_przelew24`, `tmobile_usbugi_bankowe`, `toyota_bank`, `velobank`, `volkswagen_bank`.


<a id="nestedatt--action--collect_payment_method--payment_method--paypal"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.paypal`

Read-Only:

- `country` (String) Two-letter ISO code representing the buyer's country. Values are provided by PayPal directly (if supported) at the time of authorization or settlement. They cannot be set or mutated.
- `payer_email` (String) Owner's email. Values are provided by PayPal directly
(if supported) at the time of authorization or settlement. They cannot be set or mutated.
- `payer_id` (String) PayPal account PayerID. This identifier uniquely identifies the PayPal customer.


<a id="nestedatt--action--collect_payment_method--payment_method--payto"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.payto`

Read-Only:

- `bsb_number` (String) Bank-State-Branch number of the bank account.
- `last4` (String) Last four digits of the bank account number.
- `pay_id` (String) The PayID alias for the bank account.


<a id="nestedatt--action--collect_payment_method--payment_method--pix"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.pix`

Read-Only:

- `fingerprint` (String) Uniquely identifies this particular Pix account. You can use this attribute to check whether two Pix accounts are the same.


<a id="nestedatt--action--collect_payment_method--payment_method--radar_options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.radar_options`

Read-Only:

- `session` (String) A [Radar Session](https://docs.stripe.com/radar/radar-session) is a snapshot of the browser metadata and device details that help Radar make more accurate predictions on your payments.


<a id="nestedatt--action--collect_payment_method--payment_method--sepa_debit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.sepa_debit`

Read-Only:

- `bank_code` (String) Bank code of bank associated with the bank account.
- `branch_code` (String) Branch code of bank associated with the bank account.
- `country` (String) Two-letter ISO code representing the country the bank account is located in.
- `fingerprint` (String) Uniquely identifies this particular bank account. You can use this attribute to check whether two bank accounts are the same.
- `generated_from` (Attributes) Information about the object that generated this PaymentMethod. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action--collect_payment_method--payment_method--sepa_debit--generated_from))
- `last4` (String) Last four characters of the IBAN.

<a id="nestedatt--action--collect_payment_method--payment_method--sepa_debit--generated_from"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.sepa_debit.generated_from`

Read-Only:

- `charge` (String) The ID of the Charge that generated this PaymentMethod, if any.
- `setup_attempt` (String) The ID of the SetupAttempt that generated this PaymentMethod, if any.



<a id="nestedatt--action--collect_payment_method--payment_method--sofort"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.sofort`

Read-Only:

- `country` (String) Two-letter ISO code representing the country the bank account is located in.


<a id="nestedatt--action--collect_payment_method--payment_method--upi"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.upi`

Read-Only:

- `vpa` (String) Customer's unique Virtual Payment Address


<a id="nestedatt--action--collect_payment_method--payment_method--us_bank_account"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.us_bank_account`

Read-Only:

- `account_holder_type` (String) Account holder type: individual or company. Possible values: `company`, `individual`.
- `account_type` (String) Account type: checkings or savings. Defaults to checking if omitted. Possible values: `checking`, `savings`.
- `bank_name` (String) The name of the bank.
- `financial_connections_account` (String) The ID of the Financial Connections Account used to create the payment method.
- `fingerprint` (String) Uniquely identifies this particular bank account. You can use this attribute to check whether two bank accounts are the same.
- `last4` (String) Last four digits of the bank account number.
- `networks` (Attributes) Contains information about US bank account networks that can be used. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action--collect_payment_method--payment_method--us_bank_account--networks))
- `routing_number` (String) Routing number of the bank account.
- `status_details` (Attributes) Contains information about the future reusability of this PaymentMethod. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action--collect_payment_method--payment_method--us_bank_account--status_details))

<a id="nestedatt--action--collect_payment_method--payment_method--us_bank_account--networks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.us_bank_account.networks`

Read-Only:

- `preferred` (String) The preferred network.
- `supported` (List of String) All supported networks.


<a id="nestedatt--action--collect_payment_method--payment_method--us_bank_account--status_details"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.us_bank_account.status_details`

Read-Only:

- `blocked` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action--collect_payment_method--payment_method--us_bank_account--status_details--blocked))

<a id="nestedatt--action--collect_payment_method--payment_method--us_bank_account--status_details--blocked"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.collect_payment_method.payment_method.us_bank_account.status_details.blocked`

Read-Only:

- `network_code` (String) The ACH network code that resulted in this block. Possible values: `R02`, `R03`, `R04`, `R05`, `R07`, `R08`, `R10`, `R11`, `R16`, `R20`, `R29`, `R31`.
- `reason` (String) The reason why this PaymentMethod's fingerprint has been blocked Possible values: `bank_account_closed`, `bank_account_frozen`, `bank_account_invalid_details`, `bank_account_restricted`, `bank_account_unusable`, `debit_not_authorized`, `tokenized_account_number_deactivated`.






<a id="nestedatt--action--confirm_payment_intent"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.confirm_payment_intent`

Read-Only:

- `confirm_config` (Attributes) Represents a per-transaction override of a reader configuration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action--confirm_payment_intent--confirm_config))
- `payment_intent` (String) Most recent PaymentIntent processed by the reader.

<a id="nestedatt--action--confirm_payment_intent--confirm_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.confirm_payment_intent.confirm_config`

Read-Only:

- `return_url` (String) If the customer doesn't abandon authenticating the payment, they're redirected to this URL after completion.



<a id="nestedatt--action--print_content"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.print_content`

Read-Only:

- `image` (Attributes) Metadata of an uploaded file (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action--print_content--image))
- `type` (String) The type of content to print. Currently supports `image`. Possible values: `image`.

<a id="nestedatt--action--print_content--image"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.print_content.image`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (Number) Creation time of the object (in seconds since the Unix epoch).
- `filename` (String) The original name of the uploaded file (e.g. `receipt.png`).
- `size` (Number) The size (in bytes) of the uploaded file.
- `type` (String) The format of the uploaded file.



<a id="nestedatt--action--process_payment_intent"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.process_payment_intent`

Read-Only:

- `payment_intent` (String) Most recent PaymentIntent processed by the reader.
- `process_config` (Attributes) Represents a per-transaction override of a reader configuration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action--process_payment_intent--process_config))

<a id="nestedatt--action--process_payment_intent--process_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.process_payment_intent.process_config`

Read-Only:

- `enable_customer_cancellation` (Boolean) Enable customer-initiated cancellation when processing this payment.
- `return_url` (String) If the customer doesn't abandon authenticating the payment, they're redirected to this URL after completion.
- `skip_tipping` (Boolean) Override showing a tipping selection screen on this transaction.
- `tipping` (Attributes) Represents a per-transaction tipping configuration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action--process_payment_intent--process_config--tipping))

<a id="nestedatt--action--process_payment_intent--process_config--tipping"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.process_payment_intent.process_config.tipping`

Read-Only:

- `amount_eligible` (Number) Amount used to calculate tip suggestions on tipping selection screen for this transaction. Must be a positive integer in the smallest currency unit (e.g., 100 cents to represent $1.00 or 100 to represent ¥100, a zero-decimal currency).




<a id="nestedatt--action--process_setup_intent"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.process_setup_intent`

Read-Only:

- `generated_card` (String) ID of a card PaymentMethod generated from the card_present PaymentMethod that may be attached to a Customer for future transactions. Only present if it was possible to generate a card PaymentMethod.
- `process_config` (Attributes) Represents a per-setup override of a reader configuration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action--process_setup_intent--process_config))
- `setup_intent` (String) Most recent SetupIntent processed by the reader.

<a id="nestedatt--action--process_setup_intent--process_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.process_setup_intent.process_config`

Read-Only:

- `enable_customer_cancellation` (Boolean) Enable customer-initiated cancellation when processing this SetupIntent.



<a id="nestedatt--action--refund_payment"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.refund_payment`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (Number) The amount being refunded.
- `charge` (String) Charge that is being refunded.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format.
- `payment_intent` (String) Payment intent that is being refunded.
- `reason` (String) The reason for the refund. Possible values: `duplicate`, `fraudulent`, `requested_by_customer`.
- `refund` (String) Unique identifier for the refund object.
- `refund_application_fee` (Boolean) Boolean indicating whether the application fee should be refunded when refunding this charge. If a full charge refund is given, the full application fee will be refunded. Otherwise, the application fee will be refunded in an amount proportional to the amount of the charge refunded. An application fee can be refunded only by the application that created the charge.
- `refund_payment_config` (Attributes) Represents a per-transaction override of a reader configuration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action--refund_payment--refund_payment_config))
- `reverse_transfer` (Boolean) Boolean indicating whether the transfer should be reversed when refunding this charge. The transfer will be reversed proportionally to the amount being refunded (either the entire or partial amount). A transfer can be reversed only by the application that created the charge.

<a id="nestedatt--action--refund_payment--refund_payment_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.refund_payment.refund_payment_config`

Read-Only:

- `enable_customer_cancellation` (Boolean) Enable customer-initiated cancellation when refunding this payment.



<a id="nestedatt--action--set_reader_display"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.set_reader_display`

Read-Only:

- `cart` (Attributes) Cart object to be displayed by the reader, including line items, amounts, and currency. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action--set_reader_display--cart))
- `type` (String) Type of information to be displayed by the reader. Only `cart` is currently supported. Possible values: `cart`.

<a id="nestedatt--action--set_reader_display--cart"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.set_reader_display.cart`

Read-Only:

- `currency` (String) Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies).
- `line_items` (Attributes List) List of line items in the cart. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action--set_reader_display--cart--line_items))
- `tax` (Number) Tax amount for the entire cart. A positive integer in the [smallest currency unit](https://docs.stripe.com/currencies#zero-decimal).
- `total` (Number) Total amount for the entire cart, including tax. A positive integer in the [smallest currency unit](https://docs.stripe.com/currencies#zero-decimal).

<a id="nestedatt--action--set_reader_display--cart--line_items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.set_reader_display.cart.line_items`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (Number) The amount of the line item. A positive integer in the [smallest currency unit](https://docs.stripe.com/currencies#zero-decimal).
- `description` (String) Description of the line item.
- `quantity` (Number) The quantity of the line item.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import stripe_terminal_reader.counter tmr_123
```
